svg.title: Where sworn hooks into a session
svg.desc: Twelve hook events, from the opening of the session to its end, each with the scripts that run there. SessionStart, abertura.js: at startup, resume, clear or compact, your rules and the scope come back, with the blocks of parallel work, fewer stops, response quality and less code. UserPromptSubmit, abrir-turno.js: a costly return to an idle chat pauses once, with the cost, and the next message goes on; a correction becomes a rule proposal. PreToolUse on Write and Edit, portao-escopo.js: it denies, with the reason, a write off scope, to an untouchable file or to another session's file, a new file without searching first, the ratchet (a limit that only tightens), an AAA file without the manual (the playbook) loaded, and a design token off the system. PreToolUse on Read, aviso-leitura.js: it warns, without denying, about reading a text file above 64 KB whole, once per file in the session, with the size and a reminder to read only the part. PreToolUse on Bash and PowerShell, portao-shell.js, which runs portao-destrutivo.js, portao-estilo.js, portao-commit.js and portao-pacote.js in one process: destructive command, shell syntax, stray cd, style by shell and commit without review, and a warning, without denying, about an installed package that is in neither the manifest nor the lockfile. PreToolUse on Task and Agent, portao-agente.js, portao-apelido.js and portao-juiz.js: top-tier agent on light work, the model nickname, which only warns, and the blind-review inspector raised one model step above the session's. PreToolUse on AskUserQuestion, portao-decisao.js: exactly 3 options, the recommended one first. PermissionRequest, painel-gancho.js (Claude Code only), which also runs, without holding the session, on SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse on AskUserQuestion, PostToolUse, Stop and SessionEnd: it carries each event to the live sessions panel when it is up and, with a visible panel tab, holds a permission request for up to 120 s so you can approve or deny it there; with no decision, the request goes back to the terminal. PostToolUse, SubagentStart, SubagentStop and StopFailure (a subagent stopped at the API usage limit, Claude Code only), marcar-trabalho.js, depois-do-shell.js (after the shell, marcar-trabalho.js and conferir-depois.js in one process), abrir-subagente.js, gravar-veredito.js, escalar.js and conferir-entrega.js: they count work, searches, decisions and commits, give the less-code block to subagents, save review verdicts and keep the request of a ladder agent that asks for the rung above or stops at the usage limit, and note the file a briefing asked for that the subagent did not save. PostToolUse and PostToolUseFailure on the shell, recibo-da-prova.js (after success, inside depois-do-shell.js): each test command leaves a receipt in the session, and a long green output reaches Claude as the runner summary, with the path of the full log. PreCompact, antes-do-compact.js (Claude Code only): right before compaction, the handoff this session wrote gets its sections from disk again, HEAD and git status, the next plan item and the pending items, and the judgment sections stay as they were; it never blocks. Stop, portao-fecho.js: proof, open sub-item, handoff prompt, review and reference, an escalation left undispatched, and when to switch chats. SessionEnd, fim-sessao.js: cleans session files idle for more than 7 days. A solid amber dot marks the moments that can deny or hand the turn back; a gray ring, the ones that only inject, count or clean.

g.font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Where sworn hooks into a session
Twelve hook events, from the opening to the end; PreToolUse has one row per tool
Startup, resume, clear or compact: your rules, scope and the four work blocks come back.
Idle 1 h at 200k+ tokens: one pause with the cost; send again to go on. A correction proposes a rule.
Denies: off scope, protected or other-session file, no search, ratchet, manual unread, design token.
Warns once per file, never denies, on a whole read of text over 64 KB: read only the part.
Denies destructive or wrong-shell commands, CSS via shell, unreviewed commits; fixes a stray cd.
Denies costly agents on light work, warns on a model mismatch, lifts the reviewer one model step.
A question to you: exactly 3 options, the recommended one first.
painel-gancho.js · also async: start, prompt, question, tool, Stop and SessionEnd
Claude Code only, with the live panel up: the session shows there; approve or deny for up to 120 s.
recibo-da-prova.js: a receipt per test · conferir-entrega.js: the asked file, missing
Counts work, searches, decisions, commits; less code to subagents; saves verdicts and escalations.
Before compaction: the handoff gets HEAD, git status, plan item and pending items from disk again.
Returns the turn: no proof/review/handoff/reference, open sub-item, unsent escalation, full chat.
Cleans session files idle for more than 7 days.
can deny or hand the turn back
